text: {"question":"What evidence in the results section supports the claim that the variable‑curvature model displays a decelerated phase close to redshift z = 0?","reference_answer":"The posterior distributions shown in Fig. 3, together with the joint 2D confidence regions, reveal that the deceleration parameter q₀ for the variable‑curvature model is negative at low redshift, indicating a decelerated expansion near z ≈ 0. The analysis of the curvature‑related parameters (Ω₁ᵏ, Ω₂ᵏ) in these plots further confirms that the model’s background evolution allows for such a deceleration at present times."}
